payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

fact.question: Does the background as a whole visibly read as a basketball court, rather than merely containing an isolated basketball-related feature?
fact.present_when: The background is recognizably a basketball court overall, supported by a coherent court setting such as a playing surface together with court markings or basketball equipment.
fact.absent_when: The assessable background does not read as a basketball court overall; any basketball-related feature is absent or isolated without a coherent court setting.
fact.unknown_when: The background is too obscured or unclear to judge whether it reads as a basketball court overall.
